output.subject: Your feedback about our Quarry Rd branch
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for writing to us, and we're sorry for the frustration this has caused.

You told us that the pen on a chain at our Quarry Rd branch has been broken for months, and that when you visited today there were no deposit slips available at all. We understand how aggravating it is to go into a branch to take care of your banking and find that the basics you need aren't there.

You also mentioned that you plan to close all of your accounts with us and to contact Channel 8 about your experience. We take what you've said seriously, and we want you to know your concerns have reached the right people.

Your message has been passed to our Branch & Contact Center team, who will review what you've described about the Quarry Rd branch. We will respond to you within 10 business days.

If there is anything else about your visit that you'd like us to know, please reply to this email.

Kind regards,

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Customer states intent to close all accounts; decide whether to offer a call or other outreach before they act.
Customer says they will contact Channel 8 (media); check whether this needs to be shared with the media or communications team.
Confirm with Quarry Rd branch whether the pen and deposit slip issues are current before committing to anything.
Decide whether to tell the customer about any action taken on branch supplies; the draft makes no promise.
Customer did not ask for a refund or compensation; the request is about branch supplies and equipment.
A phone number was included in the complaint; it is not used in the draft.
